stem:
The diameters, $x$ millimetres, of a random sample of 200 discs made by a certain machine were recorded. The results are summarised below.

$$n = 200 \qquad \sum x = 2520 \qquad \sum x^2 = 31\,852$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate a 95% confidence interval for the population mean diameter.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Jean chose 40 random samples and used each sample to calculate a 95% confidence interval for the population mean diameter.

How many of these 40 confidence intervals would be expected to include the true value of the population mean diameter?
